rules.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires a shot of any power, it must have a target that was scanned this very turn (age 0) and its gun must be pointing at that target within 3.0°; with no target, a stale scan, or an off-aim gun, it may not fire at all (not firing is always allowed).
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> ((obs.target matches Some(t) && t.age == 0) && aimed(*obs))

deleted_starters.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.

explanation.headline: Proved: the one rule (S2) holds
explanation.summary: Verus proved S2: the robot only fires when it has a target scanned this turn (age 0) and its gun is aimed within tolerance. The battles did report S3 violations (first on turn 2 in both arenas, 41 turns in the open and 76 in the city), but S3 was not among the rules checked here, so I can't say what it covers.
